```dsl
flowchart right
title: HTTP Retry Policy with Circuit Breaker

group Client {
  Start [ellipse, green]
  Request [rect rounded]
  Response [ellipse, blue]
  Error [rect rounded, red]
}

group RetryLogic {
  AttemptCount [doc]
  MaxReached [diamond, orange]
  Backoff [parallelogram, violet]
  Jitter [parallelogram, violet]
  Wait [rect rounded, teal]
}

group CircuitBreaker {
  CBState [hexagon, pink]
  CBOpen [diamond, red]
  CBHalfOpen [diamond, orange]
  CBClosed [diamond, green]
  FailureCount [doc]
  SuccessCount [doc]
  Threshold [doc]
}

Start -> Request : send HTTP
Request -> Response : success [thick, green]
Request -> Error : failure [thick, red]

Error -> AttemptCount : increment
AttemptCount -> MaxReached : attempt >= 5?
MaxReached -> Response : yes [red, dashed]
MaxReached -> CBState : no

CBState -> CBOpen : state = open?
CBOpen -> Error : yes [red, dashed] // fail fast
CBOpen -> CBHalfOpen : timeout elapsed?

CBHalfOpen -> Request : test request [thick]
CBHalfOpen -> CBOpen : test fails [red]
CBHalfOpen -> CBClosed : test succeeds [green]

CBState -> CBClosed : state = closed?
CBClosed -> FailureCount : on failure
FailureCount -> Threshold : failures >= 5?
Threshold -> CBOpen : yes [red]
Threshold -> Backoff : no

Backoff -> Jitter : calculate delay
Jitter -> Wait : sleep [thick]
Wait -> Request : retry [dashed, blue]

CBState -> Response : success [green]
Response -> SuccessCount : increment
SuccessCount -> CBClosed : reset failures [green]

note MaxReached : max 5 attempts
note Backoff : delay = 2^attempt * base
note Jitter : ±25% random
note CBOpen : fail fast, no request sent
note CBHalfOpen : single test request
note CBClosed : normal operation
```
